mapper.select: SELECT lp.CORP_GR AS corpGr , TO_CHAR(lp.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , ya.JASAN_GB AS jasanGb , lp.JM_CD AS yjCd , F_JM_NM(lp.CORP_GR, lp.JM_CD) AS xxYjCd , ya.BLBG_TCKR AS blbgTckr , ya.ISIN_CD AS isinCd , ya.CURRENCY AS currency , lp.JONGA AS jonga , lp.DANGA AS danga , TO_CHAR(lp.LOAD_TIME, 'MM.DD HH24:MI:SS') AS loadTime , TO_CHAR(lp.PX_CLOSE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS pxCloseDt , lp.PX_LAST AS pxLast , TO_CHAR(lp.PX_DT_1D, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS pxDt1d , lp.PX_CLOSE_1D AS pxClose1d , lp.PX_YEST_CLOSE_EXCH_UNADJ AS pxYestCloseExchUnadj , F_YJONGA(lp.CORP_GR, lp.JM_CD, lp.YMD - 1) AS junJonga , F_YDANGA(lp.CORP_GR, lp.JM_CD, lp.YMD - 1) AS junDanga FROM SYT0LP lp JOIN SYM0YA ya ON ya.CORP_GR = lp.CORP_GR AND ya.JM_CD = lp.JM_CD WHERE lp.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND lp.YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND ya.JASAN_GB = #{jasanGb} ORDER BY ya.JASAN_GB, lp.JM_CD
SELECT JM_CD FROM SYM0YA WHERE CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND JM_CD = #{yjCd} AND JASAN_GB = #{jasanGb}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO SYT0LP target USING DUAL ON (target.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND target.YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND target.JM_CD = #{yjCd}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.JONGA = #{jonga, jdbcType=NUMERIC} , target.DANGA = #{danga, jdbcType=NUMERIC} , target.LOAD_TIME = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CORP_GR, YMD, JM_CD, JONGA, DANGA, LOAD_TIME) VALUES (#{corpGr}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), #{yjCd}, #{jonga, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{danga, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SYSDATE)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SYT0LP WHERE CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND JM_CD = #{yjCd}
